data:
Today, I received the results of the PET scan done last week. The scan confirmed that the tumor in my neck is still there — and it has grown slightly, 0.15 cm since the last scan...

Next week, I will see the oncologist to discuss these results and the next steps to start treatment.

Do not be afraid, for I am with you.
Do not be anxious, for I am your God.
I will fortify you, yes, I will help you,
I will really hold on to you with my right hand of righteousness.

— Isaiah 41:10
